description: You are a SOC analyst at an e-commerce company. Your nginx web servers have been added to Wazuh monitoring, but the existing Wazuh ruleset does not detect web application attacks from nginx access logs. You need to extend Wazuh's detection capabilities by creating custom decoders and rules. Requirements: (1) Create a custom log decoder that parses nginx access log format and extracts relevant fields such as the requested URL, HTTP method, response code, and source IP — write this to Wazuh's local custom decoder file; (2) Create at minimum three custom detection rules targeting distinct web attack categories: SQL injection attempts (severity level 10 or above), path/directory traversal attempts (level 10 or above), and command injection attempts (level 9 or above); (3) At least one of the rules must include a MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping in its group classification or mitre tag. All changes must be saved to Wazuh persistently via the dashboard or API — they will be verified by inspecting Wazuh configuration files on disk. Dashboard login: admin/SecretPassword at https://localhost (accept SSL certificate warning). API credentials: wazuh-wui/MyS3cr37P450r.*- at https://localhost:55000.

metadata.description: Create nginx decoder and web attack detection rules with MITRE ATT&CK mapping
